title: Aljirinak taypin chiqapar uñjaña
intro: Mä jaqiw ganancianak jikxatañ munañamp manqʼantat mä jaqi nayraqatan saytʼasïna, jupanakarux chiqapar sarnaqapxañapataki ukat chiqapar sarnaqapxañapatakiw jawsäna. Aka Allah luqtirix mä juk’a medida churañat ukhamarak balanzas ukar mayjt’ayañat iwxt’äna. Jaqinakax janiw ist’añ munapkänti, aka jaqirux uraqipat jaqunukuñ sasaw axsarapxäna. Aka Oraqe pachpaw jupanak contra juchañchañatak sartañapäna. ¿Khitis aka jakhüwix aljirinaka taypin chiqapar uñjatäñatak sayt’asiwayi?
clues: Nayarojj mä yatiyirit khitapjjetäna, jupanakajj comercioru ukat comercio toqet wal chʼamachasipjjäna.
Markajajj mayninakatak yänak pesañatakejj mä jukʼa tiempo churapjjerïnwa.
Iyawsäwir jawstʼaskä ukhajj uka oraqetwa jaqsutäni sasaw ajjsarayapjjerïtu.
Profetanakat sipansa jukʼamp suma arstʼirit amtasipjjetu.
Markajajj mä jachʼa uraq khathatimpiw katuntatäpjjäna, ukatwa utanakapan jan jakañan uñjasipjjäna.
Nayax Hijaz alay tuqinkir Madyan jaqinakar khithatätwa.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ
verse: They said, "O Shuʿayb, does your prayer [i.e., religion] command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!" (11:87)
